raw_text:
PLAN "Pregnancy Strength Maintenance (12 weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength and functional capacity during pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Weeks 1-4 (Early Pregnancy, 0-16 weeks safe supine allowed)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower focus - strength maintenance":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_squat 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          standing_hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper push/pull - strength":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_overhead_press 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full body - moderate intensity":
        warmup:
          stationary_bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          single_arm_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          Pallof_press 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
